name: M40 Targeting System
effect: Can be fitted to any weapon with the BOLT and ADEPTUS ASTARTES Keywords, instead of a normal scope. Weapon gains Sniper (2), +1 bonus dice to ranged attacks, and reduces Range penalties by -2. Weapon reduces any Salvo and Rapid Fire ratings it has by -1.

name: Vortex Bolts
effect: Blast (1), Targets with the PSYKER Keywords take double damage and treat the attack as Agonising, A DN 9 Corruption Test is required by anyone caught in the blast. Single round only - no Salvo or Rapid Fire possible.
note: Printed under Weapon Upgrades as special munitions. Missing spaces in "asAgonising,A" restored; punctuation otherwise as printed.

name: Mk IV Imperial Maximus
note: Name as in the p.73 table; the p.69 description is headed "Mk IV Maximus Armour". Numbers agree.

name: Mk V Heresy Armour
note: Table prints "Bulky (1) Powered (2)," (comma misplaced); p.69 prints Powered (2), Bulky (1). VoA says Bulky where Core's trait is Bulk; copied as printed.

name: Mk X Tacticus Armour
effect: Sized for Primaris Marines: cannot be worn by Firstborn Astartes, and has no backwards compatibility with standard Astartes armour (p.71).

name: Mk X Gravis Armour
effect: Light enough for the wearer to use a Jump Pack if necessary (p.72).

name: Mk X Omnis Armour
effect: Incorporates a Jump Pack and a Grav-Chute (p.72).
note: p.72 also says the wearer can bear heavy weaponry such as an Accelerator Autocannon without sacrificing speed or accuracy; no mechanic is printed, so not encoded.

name: Mk X Phobos Armour
effect: +1 Movement, +2 bonus dice to Stealth (A) Tests.
note: Table traits abbreviate the p.72 Effect line, which is copied in effect. Also printed in FSPG p.125 (Mk X Phobos Power Armour, same stats, no +1 M or +2 Stealth).

name: Centurion Warsuit
effect: Size: Large. Not sized for Primaris Marines (p.72).
note: No weapon profiles are printed for the warsuit's Siege Drills or paired heavy weapons (p.72 flavour only).

name: Adamantine Cuirass
effect: +1 AR and Bulky (1) to any armour with both the POWERED and ADEPTUS ASTARTES Keywords. Reduce any Flight Speed by -2. Replaces the chest piece of a standard suit of power armour.

mods.what: replaces the chest piece of a standard suit of power armour

note: No Value, Rarity or Keywords printed. Printed under "Augmetics & Other Tools", but it names a host item, a compatibility line and profile changes, so it is an armour upgrade (rules-flow.md §11.61, which uses it as the `plate` example). VoA prints "Bulky" where Core's Trait is Bulk, as on Mk V Heresy Armour.

name: Astartes Servo-Arm
effect: You gain +5 Strength when using the Astartes Servo-Arm. The arm allows you to Brace (Wrath & Glory Core Rulebook, page 189) as a Free Action in combat. It adds +1 bonus dice to all Tech (Int) Tests to perform engineering tasks, and can be used as a melee weapon.
note: No Value, Rarity, Keywords or melee profile printed.
